package.description: The purpose of EDHM is to allow players of the game to customize their HUD Colors in many ways. This is estrictly a graphical mod, we dont change any in-game mechanics or things that FDev charges for.
package.installationNotes: The first time EDHM_UI runs, it will prompt you for the Elite Dangerous game folder. This determines where the EDHM core mod will be installed. The location varies depending on which version of ED you have installed. Simply click the Green Button and do as the Assistant says.

en-US.name: User Interface for Elite Dangerous HUD Mod
en-US.releaseNotes:
Changelog:
Change Log:
Fix for Elite Dangerous 4.4.2.0 (Anaconda MKII Update)
Changes:
Fix for Anaconda MKII Update
Fix Some Orange
Fix OnFoot HUD
Revert Status Lights Coordinates, now that the FDev Bug has been fixed
Fix HoloMe Color Selector when OnFoot
Fix Bio Scanner Zones on the Nomad's Radar
Improve the Transition between Radar and Terrain when in Ship (including Nomad)
Rework Nomad Detection to detect only its use rather than its presence on the screen
Fix Some FSS Cyan Elements
Fix Federation Cyan Icon in Compass when OnFoot

Installing on Windows:
- Download the installer: edhm-ui-v3-windows-x64.exe from the Assets.
- Run The installer.
- Program will be installed at %LOCALAPPDATA%\EDHM-UI-V3
- Shortcut will be created on Desktop.

Installing on any Linux Distribution:
- Download both edhm-ui-v3-linux-x64.zip and linux_installer.sh from the Assets.
- Place the script next the ZIP file.
- Make the script executable: chmod +x linux_installer.sh
- Run it ./linux_installer.sh
- Program will be installed at '~/.local/share/EDHM-UI-V3'
- Shortcuts will be created on Desktop and Apps List.
